title: Design System: Minhyoung An Research Index

headline.purpose: Primary section headings above strong rules.

label.purpose: Navigation, filters, metadata, years, and actions.

motion.name: ease-index
motion.purpose: The available authored easing token; interaction color transitions currently use 160ms ease.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Collapses animation and transition duration when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Section Navigation
components.description: Compact muted section links with cobalt hover and active state.
components.html: PublicationsAwards
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:26px; font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link { color:var(--muted,#565d68); font-size:.78rem; font-weight:560; text-decoration:none; transition:color 160ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover,.ds-nav-link.ds-active { color:var(--accent,#075ccf); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(7,92,207,.26); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Language Switch
components.description: Three compact language options with an underlined cobalt current state.
components.css: .ds-lang-switch { display:flex; align-items:center; padding-left:14px; border-left:1px solid var(--rule,#dfe3e8); font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; } .ds-lang-switch button { min-height:30px; padding:3px 6px; border:0; background:transparent; color:var(--soft,#737b87); font-size:.68rem; font-weight:560; cursor:pointer; } .ds-lang-switch button:hover { color:var(--text,#17191d); } .ds-lang-switch button.ds-active { color:var(--accent,#075ccf); text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:4px; } .ds-lang-switch button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(7,92,207,.26); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Publication Year Filters
components.description: Borderless year filters whose active state is a cobalt baseline.

narrative.overview:
The system presents an academic record as a precise working index: concise, institutional, and personal without becoming brand-heroic. Profile and education occupy equal adjacent columns, while publications and awards form the primary lists.

Its character comes from a cool paper field, near-black ink, restrained Research Cobalt, and a disciplined hierarchy of rules. Every treatment should help a visitor scan, verify, open, filter, or cite the work.
keyCharacteristics: Flat structure defined by rules and tonal surfaces.
Compact multilingual controls and bibliography-first density.

rules.name: The Cobalt Means Action Rule
rules.body: Use the accent for links, active filters, active navigation, copied feedback, selection, and visible focus; do not spread it across passive surfaces.

rules.name: The Evidence Before Scale Rule
rules.body: Use weight, spacing, and rules before increasing type size; there is no giant-name hero.

rules.name: The Flat Evidence Rule
rules.body: Surfaces stay on one plane; use rules and restrained tonal contrast to organize information.

dos: Do keep publications and citation actions visually dominant through density, rules, and clear metadata.
Do reserve Research Cobalt for meaningful interaction and current state.
Do preserve keyboard focus, reduced-motion behavior, high-contrast overrides, and responsive access to language and citation controls.
Do use verified profile destinations and repository-backed publication content only.
donts: Don't introduce flashy AI-startup styling, gradients, glass, or decorative imagery.
Don't turn bibliography rows into cards or add shadows.
Don't use a magazine or editorial collage composition.
Don't create a giant-name hero or brand-heroic voice.
